FAIL_TO_PASS: follow-pattern-parameters: retains side-effect-free code in pattern parameters called from try-statement-blocks
return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
context: Uses --context to set `this` value
inline-imports-with-manual: Manual chunks are not supported when inlining dynamic imports
Throws when using the "file"" option for multiple chunks
config-cjs-dirname: does not transpile cjs configs and provides correct __filename
config-mjs-plugins: supports native esm as well as CJS plugins when using .mjs in Node 13+
log-from-plugin-simple: prints logs from plugins via input options if there are no handlers
perf-supports-object-hooks: Supports object hooks with perf=true
code-splitting-named-inputs: allows defining names via CLI
interop-per-dependency-no-live-binding: allows to configure the interop type per external dependency
handles entry facades as entry points but not the facaded chunk
supports-core-js: supports core-js feature detection (#2869)
chunk-external-dependency-execution-order: Uses correct execution order when several modules in a chunk have external dependencies
deoptimize-logical-expression-reassignments: tracks reassignments of deoptimized logical expressions
inlined-namespace-static-resolution: statically resolves Symbol.toStringTag for inlined namespaces
unmodified-default-exports-function-argument: passing unbound default export to function cannot rebind it
hoisted-variable-if-stmt: Properly renders branches which refer to hoisted variables from other lexical scopes
property-keys-not-renamed: does not rename property keys
smallest: handles treeshake preset "smallest"
